
Various gamma distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $\alpha$ and\ $\beta$.




```{r, GammaDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Gamma distributions."}
###  Parameters  ###
alphas <- c(1, 2, 3)     # shape parameter α
betas  <- c(1, 2)        # scale parameter β

x <- seq(0, 15, 
         length.out = 600)  # x grid for gamma PDF

###  Compute axis ranges  ###
xrange <- c(0, 15)
# maximum of gamma PDFs over all alpha/beta
yrange <- c(0, max(sapply(alphas, 
                          function(a) sapply(betas, function(b) dgamma((a - 1) * b, 
                                                                       shape = a, 
                                                                       scale = b)))) * 1.1)

### Create figure ###
fig <- plot_ly(width = 700, 
               height = 450)

### Add all traces ###
counter <- 1
for(a in alphas){
  for(b in betas){
    fig <- fig %>% add_lines(
      x = x,
      y = dgamma(x, 
                 shape = a, 
                 scale = b),
      visible = FALSE,
      line = list(color = "steelblue", 
                  width = 2.5),
      name = paste0("α=", a, ", β=", b),
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

### Make default trace visible (first alpha/beta) ###
for(i in seq_along(fig$x$data)){
  trace <- fig$x$data[[i]]
  if(trace$name == paste0("α = ", alphas[1], ", β = ", betas[1])){
    fig$x$data[[i]]$visible <- TRUE
  } else {
    fig$x$data[[i]]$visible <- FALSE
  }
}

###  Build buttons ###
buttons <- list()
counter <- 1
for(a in alphas){
  for(b in betas){
    vis <- rep(FALSE, 
               length(alphas) * length(betas))
    vis[counter] <- TRUE
    
    # Compute mean and variance for this α, β
    mean_val <- a * b
    var_val  <- a * b^2
    
    buttons[[counter]] <- list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(
        list(visible = vis),
        list(
          title = paste0("Gamma PDF: α=", a, ", β=", b),
          xaxis = list(range = xrange),
          yaxis = list(range = yrange),
          annotations = list(
            list(
              x = 0.95, 
              y = 0.95,
              xref = "paper", 
              yref = "paper",
              text = paste0("Mean = ", round(mean_val,2), "<br>Var = ", round(var_val,2)),
              showarrow = FALSE,
              xanchor = "right", 
              yanchor = "top",
              font = list(size = 12, 
                          color = "black")
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      label = paste0("α=", a, ", β=", b)
    )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# Arrange buttons in 2 rows (β=1 top, β=2 bottom), 3 columns for α 
# Since we have 3 alphas and 2 betas, top row = β=1, bottom row = β=2
top_row_buttons    <- buttons[seq(1, length(buttons), 2)]  # β=1
bottom_row_buttons <- buttons[seq(2, length(buttons), 2)]  # β=2

# --- Layout ---
fig <- fig %>% layout(
  title = list(text = "Gamma distribution", x = 0.5),
  xaxis = list(title = "x", range = xrange),
  yaxis = list(title = "Density", range = yrange),
  updatemenus = list(
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.2,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = top_row_buttons
    ),
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.3,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = bottom_row_buttons
    )
  )
  
)

# Display plot
fig
```
